P3701 (Abu Sennan area -> El Hamra, 170 km, 12 in, 50,000 bpd) is one of several DIFFERENT Western Desert oilfield pipelines that each independently terminate at the El Hamra export terminal in Matruh: P3688 Abu Gharadig-El Hamra (140 km, 12/16 in, 60,000 bpd), P3689 Badr El Din-El Hamra (128 km, 12 in, 60,000 bpd), P0572 Mleiha-El Hamra (167 km, 16 in, 140,000 bpd), P5125 Southwest Mleiha (130 km, 10 in, 7,000 bpd), P3693 El Hamra-Sidi Krir-Alexandria (90 km, downstream leg out of El Hamra). Each has a distinct origin field, distinct length, and mostly distinct diameter/capacity -- this is a known real hub-and-spoke pattern (multiple Western Desert fields feeding one coastal export terminal), not a case of the same physical line entered under two names. No length/diameter/capacity pair on the roster duplicates P3701's 170 km / 12 in / 50,000 bpd combination. Not a duplicate.
